entry.title: The Stieger Lab opens at TUM

link.title: The Stieger Lab opens at TUM

entry.content: Christian Stieger opens his lab at the Technical University of Munich supported by a Liebig Fellowship of the Fonds der Chemischen Industrie. He is now setting up his new lab and is happy to welcome motivated students and researchers at all levels to join the group. If you are interested, please reach out!
